input_fields.name: cylindrical_face
input_fields.description: One face already identified as a cylindrical face.

input_fields.name: unit_and_span_definition
input_fields.description: Length unit and definition of the requested trimmed-face span.

result_fields.name: cylinder_measurement
result_fields.description: Radius, axis, trimmed span, unit, and face identity.

procedure: Resolve one cylindrical face and read its analytic radius/axis.
Use the declared unit_and_span_definition to measure one trimmed span from its boundary/domain.
Return cylinder_measurement and measurement_status with face identity.
Do not treat an untrimmed analytic extent as the visible face span.
rejection_rules: Reject a noncylindrical/ambiguous face, undefined span convention, or incompatible unit.
Reject span inferred only from a screenshot.
Do not repair or extend the cylindrical face.
